BiblicalUsage: Chivvar is white, and it stands once, in Daniel's vision of the Ancient of Days. His garment is white as snow and the hair of His head is like pure wool, and the throne itself is like fiery flame.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe the white in Daniel's vision is the colour of a holiness no man can approach on his own, and the Ancient of Days is still on His throne, so His whiteness is my hope and not my fear.
